description: This vertical bar chart illustrates the number of samples associated with six different reasoning categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories, which are ordered from left to right in descending order of their sample counts: Mathematical Reasoning, General Reasoning, Natural Scene Reasoning, Physical Reasoning, Logical Puzzle Reasoning, and Chemical Reasoning. The vertical axis represents the "Number of Samples" and employs a logarithmic scale (base 10), with major tick marks and corresponding horizontal dashed gridlines at 10², 10³, and 10⁴. The chart consists of six individual light blue bars, each corresponding to a category. Every bar is visually annotated with its exact numerical value positioned directly above it. The tallest bar represents Mathematical Reasoning with a value of 7025, followed by General Reasoning at 1709, Natural Scene Reasoning at 413, Physical Reasoning at 232, and Logical Puzzle Reasoning at 91. The shortest bar corresponds to Chemical Reasoning, which has a value of 49.
